author: reek
body: Platform-side clan authority. The central server that authorizes clan creation, manages the global registry of clans, handles global ManaCoin purchases by clans, and validates inter-clan operations. This is the "us" in "they buy clan tokens from us."

author: reek
body: Clans register with the platform, receive authorization tokens, and then operate independently on their own instances. The platform tracks: - Which clans exist and their public keys - Global ManaCoin balances (clan treasuries draw from here) - Inter-clan challenge validation - Pack approval pipeline - Revenue collection (platform fees from pack sales)
